 Lauri Markkanen Injury Update
 November 11, 2026 11:30 AM MST SALT LAKE CITY (November 11, 2026) – The following is an injury update on Utah Jazz forward Lauri Markkanen.
 Markkanen sustained a right hand injury during Utah’s game against Dallas on Nov. 6. Following evaluation, he was diagnosed with two nondisplaced fractures in his right hand. He will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
